correctness.rationale: The reverse-state map, four eight-sheet images and all eight restricted edge permutations were reconstructed exactly. Two root-loop permutations generate all 40320 elements of S8; two lifted cycles have coprime lengths 6 and 35. Strong connectivity of the lifted graph and the regular indegree/outdegree-two structure give primitive-matrix exponential equidistribution, then exact fixed-point counting yields all nine probabilities. The standalone verifier independently checked all target fibers on cyclic lengths 2 through 13; no finite data are used as infinite proof.

The explicit limiting image fraction 25487/40320 and all nine limiting multiplicity probabilities are canonical quantitative invariants, with a structural symmetric-group explanation and exponential finite-size approximation.
